Ask Me Anything · Week 1

Ask Me Anything: Consistency & Systems

How many days to post, and how to keep going through a hard season

Hillary · Tuesday · 6 min read

You asked how I keep showing up, so that's where we're starting.

Q1: How many days a week should I actually post?

There's no magic number, and anyone who gives you one is selling their schedule, not yours. Build a schedule you can keep in a normal week and still keep in a hard one. Steady beats perfect.

Q2: How do you keep posting through a hard season of life?

Honestly, sometimes I don't. This past year we were building a home, and some weeks I didn't post at all. But when I did post, my people showed up. That's why I build for real people, not the algorithm.
